_doc: OWNER INTERJECTION 2026-09-18 §5.3 / §17 (phase F): the canonical five-stat family as a UI + DATA CONTRACT ONLY. Nothing here changes combat: the rules field never reads this file (no live rebalance), no points are awarded in the demo, allocation exists only as a labelled PREVIEW without persistence or rewards. Values are 0–999 integers.

descriptions.FORCE: raw strength output (canon identity: Titan maximum force)
descriptions.POWER: explosive output (canon identity: Titan power, Athlete explosive all-round athleticism / power)
descriptions.ENGINE: endurance / efficiency (canon identity: Lean speed / endurance / efficient movement)
descriptions.CONTROL: coordination / balance (canon identity: Athlete coordination / control, Bage control / balance)

class_baselines._doc: the canonical numeric baselines live in the 'MAHWORLD Fitness Class Archetypes' source / class registry named by the owner. That source is NOT on this machine (searched 2026-09-19: Downloads/MAHWORLD_CHARACTERS, Downloads/MAHWORLD_CLAUDE_CHARACTER, Documents/Codex/2026-09-12; only the canon's IDENTITY sentences exist — CLAUDE_GAMEPLAY_FOUNDATION/00_CANON/MAHWORLD_GAMEPLAY_CANON.md §2 and 04_CLASS_LOADOUTS/CLASS_MOVEMENT_PATTERN_MATRIX.md §1). Numbers are never invented: every class reads null until the owner points at the file; the panel then shows 'class baseline: source not found'.

identities.ATHLETE: explosive all-round athleticism / power / coordination / control
identities.LEAN: lightweight, low unnecessary mass, speed / endurance / efficient movement
identities.BAGE: Balance Mage: magic-oriented, control / balance, buff / support stronger than the physically dominant classes

points_per_level._doc: points earned per level is UNRESOLVED between 3 and 4 (owner interjection §5.3). ONE centralized provisional entry; never hard-coded as canon anywhere else. The preview shows both totals side by side.

allocation._doc: no real points are awarded in the current demo; the panel's PREVIEW mode exercises allocation (+ / −, cap 999) without persistence, rewards or any effect on the host. Live leveling waits for the effect formulas / fairness policy.
